meta.title: Vendor Invoice Processing (PO-based)
meta.purpose: Automate posting of purchase-order-based vendor invoices in SAP: read invoice emails, extract fields, three-way match and post/park in MIRO/MIR7, with a daily report.

steps.name: Load configuration
details: Read Orchestrator assets: AP_SAP_Credential (credential), AP_Mailbox, AP_ArchiveRoot, AP_TrackingFile, AP_ReportRecipients
If any asset is missing, stop the job (SE-04)

steps.name: Read invoice emails (Outlook)
steps.action: Read unread emails with PDF attachments from folder Inbox/Incoming
details: Connect to the Outlook desktop profile for mailbox AP_Mailbox
Get all unread emails from folder Inbox/Incoming (max. 200 per run)
For each email: if it has no PDF attachment, move it to Inbox/Exceptions and mark it as read (BE-01)
outputs: list of emails with PDF attachments
steps.ui_interaction_rationale: Outlook desktop profile accessed through mail activities

steps.name: Archive PDF attachments
steps.action: Save PDF attachments to the daily archive folder
details: Create folder <AP_ArchiveRoot>\YYYY-MM-DD if it does not exist
Save each PDF attachment as <ReceivedDate yyyyMMdd>_<SenderDomain>_<OriginalFileName>.pdf (BR-01)

steps.name: Extract invoice fields
steps.action: Extract invoice header fields from the PDF
details: Extract the fields listed in Appendix A from each PDF
All mandatory fields must be found; otherwise business exception BE-02 (no queue item; email moved to Inbox/Exceptions)

steps.name: Create queue items
steps.action: Add one queue item per invoice to AP_Invoices; move email to Inbox/Queued
details: Add a queue item to AP_Invoices with the extracted fields, the archive file path and the email EntryID
Reference = <VendorVATNo>_<InvoiceNumber> (BR-07); queue uniqueness on reference is enabled
Move the email to Inbox/Queued

steps.name: Log in to SAP
steps.action: Log in to SAP PRD client 100
details: Start SAP Logon, select connection PRD – Production
On the logon screen enter Client 100, User and Password from AP_SAP_Credential, Language EN, press Enter
If the 'License information for multiple logon' popup appears, select 'Continue with this logon, without ending any other logons'
Verify the SAP Easy Access screen is shown (SE-01 if not after 60 s)
decision_points: Easy Access not shown after 60 s -> SE-01
steps.ui_interaction_rationale: drives SAP Logon and the SAP GUI logon screen

steps.name: Duplicate check
details: Open AP_Tracking.xlsx, sheet Log
If a row exists with the same VendorVATNo and InvoiceNumber and Status = Posted or Parked, the invoice is a duplicate (BE-03)
steps.ui_interaction_rationale: Excel workbook read via Excel activities

steps.name: Display purchase order (ME23N)
steps.action: Display the PO and read vendor, status, net value, currency, GR quantity
details: Enter transaction /nME23N in the command field
Click 'Other Purchase Order' (Shift+F5), enter the PO number, confirm
Read from the header: Vendor number, Vendor name, Currency, PO status (field 'Status' on tab Status)
Read from the item overview, for each item: Net price, PO quantity, and from tab 'PO History': goods-receipt quantity
If 'Purchase order does not exist' appears -> BE-04; if the PO is completed/closed -> BE-05

steps.name: Three-way match
steps.action: Three-way match: invoice vs PO vs goods receipt
details: Compare invoice net amount with sum of (GR quantity × net price) over all PO items, and invoice currency with PO currency, applying BR-04 and BR-05
Mismatch -> BE-06

steps.name: Post or park the invoice (MIRO / MIR7)
steps.action: Post (MIRO) or park (MIR7) the invoice and capture the SAP document number
details: If gross amount (CHF equivalent) > 25,000 -> /nMIR7 (park); otherwise /nMIRO (post) (BR-06)
Company code popup: enter 1000 if requested
Tab 'Basic data': Invoice date, Reference (= InvoiceNumber), Amount (= GrossAmount), Currency, Calculate tax = checked, Tax code V1 (or V0 if VAT = 0)
PO reference tab: enter PO number, press Enter; verify the proposed items
Check the balance indicator is green (0.00). If not -> BE-06
Click Post (MIRO) or Save as completed (MIR7)
Read the status bar message 'Document no. 51xxxxxxxx created' and store the document number
If SAP returns an error message in the status bar -> SE-03 (retry)

steps.name: Update tracking workbook
details: Append a row to sheet Log: Timestamp, VendorVATNo, VendorName, InvoiceNumber, PONumber, GrossAmount, Currency, Status (Posted / Parked / Business Exception), SAPDocumentNumber, ExceptionReason, RobotName

steps.name: Daily summary email
steps.action: Send the daily summary email to the AP team at end of run
details: At the end of the Performer run (or 18:00 at latest), send an email to AP_ReportRecipients with subject 'AP Robot – Daily Summary <date>' and the counts of Posted, Parked, Business Exceptions and System Exceptions, with the list of business exceptions attached as Excel

applications.name: Microsoft Outlook (classic desktop)
applications.used_for: Reading invoice emails from the shared mailbox ap-invoices@nordhorn.example; moving processed emails

applications.name: SAP GUI for Windows
applications.used_for: ME23N (Display Purchase Order), MIRO (Enter Incoming Invoice), MIR7 (Park Invoice)

applications.name: UiPath Orchestrator
applications.access: assets AP_SAP_Credential, AP_Mailbox, AP_ArchiveRoot, AP_TrackingFile, AP_ReportRecipients; queue AP_Invoices

business_rules.text: Archive file names must be unique; if a file with the same name exists, append _2, _3, …
Mandatory fields: VendorVATNo, InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate, PONumber, NetAmount, VATAmount, GrossAmount, Currency.
An invoice (VendorVATNo + InvoiceNumber) may only be posted once.
Amount tolerance: |invoice net − matched net| ≤ min(2% of matched net, CHF 50).
Invoice currency must equal PO currency.
Invoices with gross amount > CHF 25,000 (CHF equivalent) are parked (MIR7), not posted, for four-eyes approval.
Queue item reference = <VendorVATNo>_<InvoiceNumber>; duplicates are rejected by the queue.

exceptions.handling: Move email to Inbox/Exceptions; no queue item.

exceptions.description: Mandatory invoice field missing or unreadable
exceptions.handling: Move email to Inbox/Exceptions; no queue item; include in summary.
Do not post; status 'Business Exception – Duplicate'.

exceptions.description: PO does not exist in SAP
exceptions.handling: Do not post; forward the PDF to the buyer mailbox purchasing@nordhorn.example.
Do not post; status 'Business Exception – PO closed'.

exceptions.description: Three-way match failed (amount, currency or balance not zero)
exceptions.handling: Do not post; status 'Business Exception – Mismatch' with the difference amount.

exceptions.description: SAP logon fails or Easy Access not reached within 60 s
exceptions.handling: Close SAP, retry login up to 3 times; then stop the job and alert rpa-coe@nordhorn.example.

exceptions.description: SAP session not responding / unexpected popup
exceptions.handling: Take screenshot, close all SAP sessions, re-login; queue item retried (max. 2).
Take screenshot; queue item set to Failed (Application Exception); retried (max. 2).

exceptions.description: Orchestrator asset missing or file share not reachable
exceptions.handling: Stop the job immediately; alert RPA CoE.

transaction.volumes: approx. 2,400 invoices per month (peak 900 in the last 3 business days of the month)
transaction.retry_policy: System exceptions retried automatically (max. 2 retries); business exceptions not retried

schedule.schedule: Dispatcher: every hour 07:00–18:00, Monday–Friday (Europe/Zurich); Performer: queue trigger on AP_Invoices, max. 2 concurrent robots
schedule.sla: Compliant invoices posted within 24 hours of email receipt

robot_environment.description: Unattended robots on Windows 11 VDI, SAP GUI 8.0, Microsoft 365 Apps (Outlook, Excel) installed

assumptions.text: Goods receipts are posted in SAP before the invoice is processed.
The SAP GUI scripting setting is not required; the robot interacts through the UI.
The shared mailbox folder structure (Incoming, Queued, Exceptions) exists.

out_of_scope.text: Invoices without a PO (non-PO invoices) and credit notes.
Invoices in languages other than DE, EN, FR, IT.

open_questions.text: Value of the AP_TrackingFile asset (path of AP_Tracking.xlsx) is not stated in S01; the workbook path appears only in §3.3.
open_questions.reason: configuration value; defaults to the §3.3 path
